svg.desc: ScadaCraft OpenBridge widget: Alert icon (obc-alert-icon, OpenBridge 1.0.0, Apache-2.0). Library: OpenBridge · Alerts and status. Box 48x48 px, anchor at (0,0). Bindable properties: _pb_active (default false, read): Alert active (icon shown in colour; hidden when inactive and _pb_hideInactive) _pb_acknowledged (default false, read): Acknowledged _ps_type (default 'alarm', read): Type: alarm | warning | caution _pb_hideInactive (default false, read): Hide the icon while the alert is not active
